page.layout: One page of text in a single column; a marginal note in the left margin ("(2) Divisio."); a centred chapter heading "Cap. 2." with a title line and a smaller italic sub-heading below it.

main_text.p: Imperium constituit & Schingvi{s} Khan, i e. Rex Regum appellatus fuit. A quo tempore cuniversa Scythia Tartaria, Scythæ Tartari, sive, ut vulgo loquuntur, Tatari vocati fuerunt. Cujus nominis occasio inde fluxit, quod in illa expeditione Schingvis Khanica Tartari, qui fuerunt tribus sive Horda Scytharum, semper præmitterentur, adeoque, sparsa adventus eorum fama, cum populus passim inclamaret Tartaros advenire, nomen illud paulatim universo exercitui, mox toti genti, fuit impositum; ut quicunque obedirent Schingvi Khano, sive Imperatori Schytarum, Tartari dicerentur.
main_text.head: Cap. 2.
Imperium Tartaricum divisum fuit in varia regna.
main_text.p: Schingvis Khan paulo ante obitum suum inter filios suos universum...

page.notes: Left margin: "(2) Divisio." — printed beside the heading. The first paragraph's page-level italics ("Tartaria", "Tatari") are reproduced as printed. The sub-heading "Explicati 1." is italic and treated as a title line. The final line is cut off at the page edge ("universum" / "fum") and is only partly legible; the last word "sum" is read as "fum" in print and may be uncertain. The superscript mark "{s}" after "Schingvi" and the "{z}" mark on the sub-heading are reconstructed from the printed daggers/asterisks and are uncertain. Right-hand column edge is clipped; some words at line ends (e.g. "universum", "Scythæ") are uncertain and may be incomplete.
